title: 更好的联机 / Better Multiplayer
description:
[h1]更好的联机[/h1]
保留官方好友联机，并增加密码房间、篝火物品交易、帮助队友锻造和商店金币交易。连接使用 Steam 大厅与中继，无需端口映射或第三方内网穿透。

[h2]主要功能[/h2]
[list]
[*]通过准确的房间名称和密码与非 Steam 好友联机
[*]在篝火交换卡牌、遗物和药水
[*]消耗自己的篝火行动，为队友升级一张牌
[*]在商店中与队友交换金币
[*]在多人菜单中一键发送脱敏诊断反馈
[/list]
所有玩家必须安装本 Mod、BaseLib，并使用相同版本。掉线后请由房主重新创建房间并选择“读档多人游戏”。

[h2]诊断反馈与隐私[/h2]
只有玩家主动点击“发送反馈”时才会上传一次诊断；不包含截图、存档、原始日志、Steam ID 或昵称、房间信息、密码、本机路径、其他 Mod 列表或玩家输入文本。

[h1]Better Multiplayer[/h1]
Keeps the official friends-only multiplayer flow and adds password rooms, Rest Site item trades, Smith for a Teammate, and gold trading at merchants. Connections use Steam lobbies and relay, so no port forwarding or third-party tunneling is required.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Play with non-friends by entering the exact room name and password
[*]Trade Cards, Relics, and Potions at Rest Sites
[*]Spend your Rest Site action to upgrade a card for another player
[*]Trade gold with another player at merchants
[*]Send anonymized diagnostics with one click from the multiplayer menu
[/list]
Every player needs this mod, BaseLib, and the same mod version. After a disconnect, the host must create a new room and choose Load Multiplayer Run.

[h2]Diagnostic Feedback & Privacy[/h2]
A diagnostic is uploaded only when the player clicks Send Feedback. It excludes screenshots, saves, raw logs, Steam IDs or names, room details, passwords, local paths, other mod lists, and player-entered text.

[h2]前置 / Requirement[/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3737335127]BaseLib[/url]

[h2]开源[/h2]
本 Mod 的原创源代码与原创 Mod 素材已在 GitHub 以 MIT License 开源，欢迎查看源代码、提交问题和参与改进。
[url=https://github.com/Isyyyue/sts2-better-multiplayer]GitHub 源代码仓库[/url]

[h2]Open Source[/h2]
This mod's original source code and original mod artwork are open source on GitHub under the MIT License. You can review the source, report issues, and contribute improvements.
[url=https://github.com/Isyyyue/sts2-better-multiplayer]GitHub Source Repository[/url]

[*]Improved retry, rate-limit, and page-navigation handling for feedback uploads
[*]Continues to support both the default branch and public-beta
